Lemon Chicken

Bright weeknight chicken with lemon & garlic.

Prep 15 minutes, cook 1 hour. Serves four.

Ingredients

  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 4 chicken thighs
  • 1 lemon, sliced

Method

  1. Heat the oil in a large pan.
  2. Brown the chicken for 10 minutes.
  3. Add the lemon and roast for 45 minutes.
